headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of August 25, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 24.18% compared to SPY's 13.11%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 11.07%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a significant return of 45.39%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 10.53%, highlighting a notable disparity within the portfolio set. Such relative performance is particularly relevant during periods of market stress, as it suggests resilience against broader market fluctuations. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
